summary: The filing is an 8-K by iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF announcing a routine cash distribution of $351,669.96 from staking rewards to shareholders of record on June 8, 2026, payable June 9, 2026. It describes ongoing monthly-to-quarterly distributions from staking proceeds, net of fees. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, going-private, activist, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, rights offering, or capital return event is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on other events, not a special situation.
